Rules: STRICTLY READ-ONLY. usql: open session-store.db with ?mode=ro; single SELECT / FTS MATCH statements only; LIMIT 50; select only needed columns.
All sessions may be searched. The '## Session' block names the current session so you can include or exclude it as the caller asks.
export-events.csx: always pass --out "$env:TEMP\copilot-history\<id>.json" and redirect stdout to $null; never write into session folders. Delete your scratch files before finishing.
Never modify session-state folders, session-store.db, project files or configuration.

CliTools.Name: usql
CliTools.UseCase: Search session-store.db. Example: `usql "sqlite:///C:/Users/USER/.copilot/session-store.db?mode=ro" -c "select session_id, source_type, substr(content,1,200) from search_index where search_index match 'worktree' limit 20" -J`.

CliTools.Name: dotnet-script
CliTools.UseCase: Run the session telemetry export: `dotnet script "$HOME\.copilot\session-state\scripts\export-events.csx" <events.jsonl> --out <temp file> > $null`.
